purpose: Test whether encoder coefficient-node masking changes Mobius-minus-raw closed-loop return in the original MaMuJoCo MIF training protocol.
native: mte.structured_controls.train mif_edge; batch512 hidden108, Adam1e-3 warmup/decay, 30percent coordinate masking with first-horizon empty-subset boundary; original loss and history.
visibility: visible arms pass all-true input visibility but retain exactly the SAME random loss partitions and native weights. This isolates visibility; it is not the preceding full-visibility route objective.
coordinates: Raw changes only Mobius/zeta buffers to identity. Mask indices and random sequences match, but masking different bases does not remove identical raw-table information.
primary: Three prespecified contrasts: masked Mobius-minus-raw, visible Mobius-minus-raw, and their difference (masked minus visible). Single three-test Holm family; exact two-sided sign flip and descriptive paired t95 across five upstream seeds after averaging all five budgets and five nested decoder repeats.
interpretation: Positive difference-in-differences supports masking improving relative Mobius return in this setting. Existing seeds0-4 and examined dataset: follow-up development evidence, not fresh task confirmation.
stopping: Complete all20 upstream models and500 controls regardless of direction. No seed/budget/model selection by scores. Stop dispatch on error; retain partial outputs.
native_parity: Before any grounding compare all five native masked Mobius representation and policy weights to accepted repaired archives, maxabs tolerance1e-5; mismatch stops dispatch for investigation.
visibility_scope: Only MIF has native stochastic masking; do not invent masked Simple/Graph variants under their original names.
prior_route: Previous full-visibility route study retained read-only as background, not subtracted to estimate masking effect.
